facts.fact: The UN announced in July 2025 the installation, for the Ministry of Justice e-Justice pilot at the Pikine-Guediawaye courthouse, of a mini data centre and a backup site; main site at the Pikine-Guediawaye courthouse (Dakar suburbs), backup place not stated; the document gives no date for entry into service beyond the July 2025 installation.
facts.system: e-Justice pilot mini data centre and backup site
